title: md.bar.v1
description: Canonical OHLCV bar. Strict superset of the FX-OB-Research-Lab candles.csv columns. UTC only. Higher timeframes are always derived from the lowest stored resolution by the single canonical aggregator; bars are stamped at their OPEN time.

schema.description: Contract identifier and version. Additive changes do not bump the major version; shape-breaking changes do (md.bar.v2) and run side-by-side during migration.

symbol.description: Canonical symbol (e.g. EURUSD). Venue spellings are mapped to canonical at the feed edge and never cross this contract boundary.

domain.description: Asset-class discriminator. Only FX is used now; the field exists from day one so Futures is additive.

timeframe.description: Bar interval. M15 = detection, 1m = execution in the existing Lab.

ts.description: Bar OPEN time in UTC, ISO-8601 (e.g. 2025-05-18T21:00:00Z). The bar is considered closed when the next interval begins.

open.description: Open price at full source precision.

high.description: High price. Must be >= max(open, close, low).

low.description: Low price. Must be <= min(open, close, high).

close.description: Close price at full source precision.

volume.description: Bar volume (tick or real volume per source). >= 0.

is_closed.description: True only for finalized bars. Strategy/ghost/replay consume closed bars only; emitting a forming bar as closed is a look-ahead bug.

source.description: Provenance of this bar. 'replay' and 'live' must produce byte-identical OHLCV for the same (symbol,timeframe,ts).

session.description: DERIVED on emit (pure function of ts, UTC-hour boundaries matching ghost_tracker.py). Included for consumer convenience; never stored as system of record.
